verdict.rationale: Gemini, as evidenced here, is a consumer AI assistant app, so it plays the MCP client role rather than serving tools to other agents. Its Connected Apps feature (gemini-docs-10) is client-side integration and does not count toward an MCP server. The evidence shows no first-party MCP server mode or endpoint, and the probe found no MCP discovery surface on gemini.google.com, so the server axis is a category error for this product.
